petition.title: Demand Fair Processing for All Vulnerable Asylum Seekers
petition.addressee: To: CGVS / Commissariaat-generaal voor de Vluchtelingen en de Staatlozen
petition.p1: We, the undersigned, call upon the Belgian asylum authority (CGVS) to ensure a transparent, humane, and individualized assessment for all applicants. Every story deserves to be heard with the gravity and dignity it warrants.
petition.p2: Current systemic delays and rigid procedural hurdles are leaving thousands of vulnerable individuals in a state of legal and emotional limbo. We urge for a reform that prioritizes safety and the fundamental right to seek protection without prejudice.
petition.p3: Our community stands united in the belief that this platform isn't just a slogan — it's a requirement for a just society. We ask you to review current protocols and reaffirm Belgium's commitment to human rights and international protection standards.

about.title: About Us
about.heroTitle: Because every voice deserves to be counted.
about.heroDescription: Voice For All was born from a simple truth: legal status should never be a barrier to human dignity or civic participation.
about.founderP1: It started in a windowless community center in 2018. I met Elena, a mother of three who had lived in our city for twelve years. She was the heart of her neighborhood, yet because of her "pending" status, she had no channel to report a dangerous intersection near her children's school.
about.founderP2: I realized then that "legal limbo" isn't just a bureaucratic state — it's a form of silence. Voice For All was founded to provide that channel. We aren't just an app; we are a megaphone for the marginalized.
about.legalDesc: We work with pro-bono lawyers to simplify complex legislation into actionable citizen insights for those in transition.
about.inclusionDesc: Empowering migrants to co-create policy regardless of their current documentation status.
about.united: United by shared futures, not just papers.
